messages.content:
这是我正在做的练习题。
Passage:
Nowadays, pollution is becoming worse and worse. A starry night seems to be a luxury for people living in cities. Is there any ideal place for stargazers ? A small town in New Zealand is here to surprise you with its breathtaking starry night sky.
Lake Tekapo is located at the heart of New Zealand's South Island. It has been a popular tourist destination for stargazers. At night, innumerable stars dot the sky above the small town. The Milky Way and various constellations can be clearly seen. Visitors can also watch meteors shooting across the sky. For people living in big cities, these can only be seen in movies or fairytales.
Though stargazing is common for people in Lake Tekapo, the local people have paid great attention to protecting their starry night sky. After midnight, all landscape lights must be turned off. In 2005, Lake Tekapo's starry night sky was even listed as a world heritage .
Besides its starry sky, the town has many other things to offer. One of them is the flower, Russell Lupin. Every summer, Russell Lupins make Lake Tekapo more attractive. However, once the Russell Lupins die off, the banks of Lake Tekapo look bare.
After reading the above introduction of Lake Tekapo, you must envy the local people a lot, because they can see the starry sky every night and appreciate the beauty of Russell Lupin every summer. If you are interested in Lake Tekapo, why not go and visit it this coming summer vacation?

Problem:
What do the local people do to protect their starry night sky?

Options:
A. Plant the flower, Russell Lupin
B. turn off all landscape lights
C. Put it in the list of world heritages
D. Offer many others things for tourists
这题我卡住了。请先帮我拆出一个能动手的小步骤，不要给完整答案。

本题知识目标：Reading Comprehension - Specific Action/Detail。参考答案是上游未认证材料，须独立核验；参考有争议时不得盲从，不因合理异解扣分。围绕本题已知条件和设问，给一个具体、可执行的最小下一步，不将题面复述或“再想想”当有效帮助。不直接代做最终答案/完整解法，不要求先重述已经明确的题意。
评价实际辅导组织：1分无帮助/重复兜底；2分明显断层或错误引导；3分方向正确但泛泛；4分利用学生证据、步骤连贯、下一步可执行；5分进一步针对卡点调整表征与提示量。正确作答（含附有实质推理的选择/判断题）可准确简短确认，部分正确可先肯定正确部分再追问缺失维度，不强迫追问；裸猜选择/判断题保持选项边界。

grading.reference_response:
The correct answer is supported by the sentence in the third paragraph which states, "After midnight, all landscape lights must be turned off." This action is explicitly described as the measure taken by local people to protect their starry night sky.

Option A is incorrect because planting Russell Lupins is mentioned as a way to make the town attractive in summer, not as a method for protecting the sky. Option C is incorrect because the text says the sky "was even listed as a world heritage" in 2005, which is a result or status, not an action performed by the people to protect it. Option D is incorrect because offering other things for tourists is a general feature of the town, not a specific protective measure for the night sky.

B
